meta.title: PUBG Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert sensitivity from any FPS to PUBG. Accurate mouse sensitivity calculation.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your PUBG general sensitivity, plus individual scope sensitivities if you use them. PUBG has separate settings for each magnification level.
steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the game to convert to. PUBG's multiple sensitivity scopes can be converted individually to match each magnification in the target game.
steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted sensitivity. PUBG's realistic gunplay means the feel differs from arcade shooters — test in training mode first.
desc: Convert sensitivity from any FPS to PUBG. Accurate mouse sensitivity calculation.
